enrichment.name: The Edge
enrichment.density_note: ultra-boutique — 15 units on 0.64 acres, single block
enrichment.notes: RERA TNRERA/29/BLG/0387/2025 matches exactly, but the project is at GOPALAPURAM, not Mylapore (adjacent central-Chennai neighbourhood, same Mylapore taluk). Price is 'On Request' on every source including the developer's own site — no per-sqft or ticket figure is published anywhere, so pricing is left null rather than inferred. Very large 4BHK-only floorplates (3,216–7,011 sqft), three open courtyards for resort-style living, swimming pool, gym, kids' play area; RERA outer completion date is 01-09-2033.

enrichment.name: Casagrand Zanora
enrichment.density_note: ultra-boutique — 15 units on 4.9 grounds (~11,991 sqft), 3 floors
enrichment.notes: RERA confirmed on Casagrand's own site. Kasturba Nagar, Adyar — 15 exclusive 3BHK units, now marked SOLD OUT by the developer and by findbhk, so this is an inventory-exhausted launch. Developer quotes ₹14,200/sqft against a stated market rate of ₹17,000/sqft; Italian marble flooring, TOTO/KOHLER fittings, 100% DG backup, seismic Zone-II RCC frame.

enrichment.name: Millennium By Dac
enrichment.density_note: mid-density single block, stilt+5 floors — 138 units on ~1 acre (17 grounds)
enrichment.notes: RERA record for TNRERA/1/BLG/0221/2026 confirms 'MILLENNIUM BY DAC', promoter DAC Promoters, 138 units, 3,947.97 sqm, at Gerugambakkam village, Kundrathur union — Kancheepuram DISTRICT, but functionally the Porur/Mannivakkam belt (2.8 km from Porur Junction), not Kancheepuram town. Portals still list the earlier registration TNRERA/1/BLG/0289/2025 for the same 138-unit/0.97-acre project, so 0221/2026 appears to be a re-registration. RERA outer completion is 31-07-2031 vs portal handover of Aug 2027 — wide gap. NoBroker quotes ₹49.97L–₹70.38L on a carpet-area basis (642–1,047 sqft); the ₹68–83L range above is the saleable-area basis and is internally consistent with ₹8,300–8,437/sqft. Amenities: gym, multipurpose hall, kids' play area, senior-citizen reflexology zone, STP, rainwater harvesting.

enrichment.name: Shivalaya
enrichment.density_note: ultra-boutique — 10 units on 0.13 acres (529.5 sqm), stilt+5 floors
enrichment.notes: DEVELOPER ATTRIBUTION IS WRONG in the source record: the TNRERA registry shows TNRERA/29/BLG/0165/2026 belongs to M/s. BEAVER CONSTRUCTION COMPANY (marketed as 'Beaver Shivalaya' / 'Beavers Shivalaya'), NOT DRA Homes — DRA's own Chennai portfolio page lists no Shivalaya and no Mylapore project at all. Address is T.M. Sundarajan Road / West Circular Road, Mandavelipakkam (Mandaveli), Mylapore taluk. Registered 11-05-2026, RERA completion 30-06-2027, total project cost ₹22 Cr (₹10 Cr land + ₹12 Cr construction). Single uniform 1,750 sqft 3BHK floorplate at a steep ₹23,485/sqft; uses premium FSI with TOD benefit. Amenities are minimal — lift and car parking only.

enrichment.name: Raghu
enrichment.notes: RERA TNRERA/29/BLG/0012/2026 confirmed; marketed as 'India Raghu' by India Builders Ltd. Sited at BESANT NAGAR rather than Adyar proper, though it falls inside the wider Adyar zone. Uniform 3BHK: 980 sqft carpet / 1,401 sqft built-up / 1,550 sqft super built-up. Ticket quoted as ₹3.41 Cr onwards by NoBroker and ₹3.95 Cr elsewhere; the per-sqft band is DERIVED by dividing those tickets by the 1,550 sqft super built-up area, not directly published. Possession is unusually distant (Dec 2030) for a 10-unit boutique block. Amenities: CCTV, power backup, STP, rainwater harvesting, lift, fire safety.

enrichment.name: Lancor Ananya
enrichment.density_note: boutique — 48 residences, only 4 apartments per floor
enrichment.notes: RERA TNRERA/29/BLG/0194/2026 dated 08-06-2026 confirmed on Lancor's own project page. NO PRICE IS PUBLISHED anywhere — developer site, 99acres (403-blocked), Housing, MagicBricks, SquareYards, Houssed and AddressOfChoice all omit it, so price_sqft and ticket are left null rather than inferred. For context only (NOT a project quote), Lancor's own market commentary puts Alwarpet/Mylapore at ₹17,000–24,400/sqft with ultra-luxury pockets beyond ₹29,000/sqft. Warren Road address; developer flags 'Only 1 Unit Available', so it is effectively sold out. Lancor is BSE/NSE-listed with a 41-year on-time delivery record and claims one of the earliest handovers among central-Chennai 2026 luxury launches. Imported marble, twin stretcher lifts, 100% backup, EV charging for every apartment, pool, gym, party hall, double-height lobby.

enrichment.name: Shriram Koyambedu project (working name)
enrichment.density_note: single G+16 tower — 135 residences on 1.96 acres, ~3.2 lakh sqft saleable
enrichment.notes: PROJECT NOW NAMED AND REGISTERED: official working name is 'Codename King Life', and it HAS a RERA number — TNRERA/29/BLG/0191/2026 — confirmed on Shriram Properties' own site (record says 'no RERA no. yet', which is stale). Shriram's official pages give config (3 & 4 BHK), 135 units and RERA but publish NO price; the per-sqft and ticket figures come from Shriram channel-partner microsites, so treat as indicative. Those partner sites disagree slightly (₹1.8–3.7 Cr vs ₹1.94–4.10 Cr); the ₹1.8–3.7 Cr band is used as it reconciles exactly with the stated ₹12,500–13,000/sqft across 1,465–2,835 sqft. Carpet efficiency quoted at 71–75%. Estimated revenue potential ₹350–400 Cr under Shriram's asset-light model. USPs: 1 minute to Koyambedu Metro, direct Poonamallee High Road (NH-48) access, 20,000 sqft clubhouse, sky pool, 10,000 sqft promenade, 1.4 acres open-to-sky, mini theatre, amphitheatre, business centre.

enrichment.name: TVS Emerald Serene Springs
enrichment.density_note: compact high-density — 237 units in 2 towers of 16 floors on 1.8 acres
enrichment.notes: SENIOR LIVING CONFIRMED — TVS Emerald's first senior-living community, operated in JV with Serene Communities by Columbia Pacific, India's largest senior-living operator. A RERA NUMBER DOES EXIST: TN/35/Building/0599/2024 per NoBroker (record says 'no RERA no. yet', which is stale). Developer price ladder: 1BHK-1T 959–976 sqft from ₹74L, 1BHK-2T 1,027 sqft from ₹77.90L, 2BHK-2T 1,183–1,217 sqft from ₹97L (up to ₹99.78L). Per-sqft band is DERIVED from those ticket/size pairs, not directly published. NoBroker's ₹70.67L–₹95.04L is on carpet area (604–767 sqft). Age-friendly build: uniform floor levels with ramps, wide doorways, universal toilets, support rails, Braille-signed lifts. Services: on-site clinic with nursing staff, 24/7 ambulance, physiotherapy, annual health checks, community dining, meal delivery, housekeeping, concierge, salon, shuttle. Kelambakkam–Vandalur Road / Thaiyur, OMR.

enrichment.name: Vgn Heritage Springz - Phase - Ii
enrichment.config_mix: CMDA-approved residential plots (incl. 16 EWS plots + 1 shop site)
enrichment.density_note: plotted layout — 100 plots (83 regular + 16 EWS + 1 shop) on 4.31 acres, 8,611 sqm plottable
enrichment.notes: PHASE II RERA RECORD FULLY CONFIRMED: TNRERA/35/LO/0980/2026, promoter VGN Homes Pvt Ltd, registered 13-03-2026, 17,422 sqm layout, 100 plots, total project cost ₹15 Cr (₹14 Cr land + ₹1 Cr development), RERA status 'Completed'. LOCATION CORRECTION: the layout is at Ottiyambakkam village — Tambaram TALUK, Chengalpattu district — which is the Medavakkam–OMR belt, not Tambaram town or the GST Road corridor. CONFIDENCE SET TO 'estimated' FOR PRICING ONLY: no portal lists Phase II separately, so the plot-size band (700–1,683 sqft), ₹5,099–5,399/sqft and ₹36L–91L ticket range are carried over from the combined/Phase-I listing (Phase I = TN/35/Layout/2358/2025, 101 plots, 4.27 acres); unit counts, land area and dates above are Phase-II-specific from the RERA record. Phase II's 8,611 sqm plottable across 100 plots implies ~927 sqft average, consistent with that band. Portals show 'ready to move'. Amenities: elevated blacktop roads, underground EB with transformers, solar LED street lights, jogging track with reflexology pathway, outdoor gym, senior citizens' court, amphitheatre, sandpit play equipment, storm-water trench, 24x7 water.
